task1.title: Request for a New Service at a Local Gym
task1.prompt: You recently joined a new gym and have noticed that it lacks a particular service that you believe would benefit many members. Write a letter to the gym manager. In your letter, explain what the service is, why you think it would be useful, and how it might improve the gym experience for members.

task2.title: Impact of Technology on Communication
task2.prompt: In recent years, technology has drastically changed the way we communicate. Some people believe this has had a positive impact, while others argue that it has led to a decline in face-to-face interaction. Discuss both views and give your own opinion on the matter.
